title: Trigger
description: Raised by the Stats Engine when a threshold is crossed, a key event happens, or 30 s of match time pass. The Moment Detector runs on every trigger.

seq.description: seq of the last event the Stats Engine had processed when the trigger fired.

value.description: The measured value, e.g. 33.4 for a 33.4 km/h sprint.

event_ids.description: Evidence: the events behind the trigger (most recent last).

TriggerKind.description: speed: a player above 32 km/h. pass_difficulty: a completed pass above 80. xg: a shot above 0.3 xG. momentum_swing: the Control vs Chaos index moved 30+ points in 5 minutes. tick: 30 s of match time passed.
